en fjende.explanation: "En fjende" means "an enemy", someone who is against you, in a war or in everyday life. Hun har ikke en eneste fjende (She does not have a single enemy).

sentence.da: Kongen sendte soldater mod sin **fjende**.
sentence.en: The king sent soldiers against his enemy.

en fjer.explanation: "En fjer" means "a feather". It can also mean the soft filling in a pillow or duvet: en pude med fjer (a pillow with feathers).

sentence.da: Fuglen har en lang **fjer** på vingen.
sentence.en: The bird has a long feather on its wing.

en fjerdedel.explanation: "En fjerdedel" means "a quarter", one of four equal parts. It is built from fjerde (fourth) and del (part), the same way as en femtedel (a fifth).

sentence.da: Jeg betaler en **fjerdedel** af huslejen.
sentence.en: I pay a quarter of the rent.

en fjernbetjening.explanation: "En fjernbetjening" means "a remote control", a small device you use to control something from a distance. It is built from fjern (far) and betjening (operation). Betjening also means "service", as in god betjening (good service).

sentence.da: Man bruger en **fjernbetjening** til at skifte kanal.
sentence.en: You use a remote control to change channels.

en fjord.explanation: "En fjord" means "a fjord", a long, narrow stretch of water that reaches into the land.

sentence.da: Skibet sejler ind i en **fjord**, ikke ud på havet.
sentence.en: The ship sails into a fjord, not out to sea.

en flagermus.explanation: "En flagermus" means "a bat", the small animal that flies and sleeps hanging upside down. It is a mammal, and the name means a fluttering mouse: flagre (to flutter) plus mus (a mouse).

sentence.da: Om natten jager en **flagermus** insekter i mørket.
sentence.en: At night, a bat hunts insects in the dark.

en flagstang.explanation: "En flagstang" means "a flagpole", a pole in a garden or outside a building that a flag is raised on. Danes often fly the flag on birthdays, so many gardens have one.

sentence.da: Flaget sidder øverst på en høj **flagstang**.
sentence.en: The flag is at the top of a tall flagpole.

en flamme.explanation: "En flamme" means "a flame", the bright, hot light that rises from something burning. As in English, en gammel flamme (an old flame) is a former love.

sentence.da: Når du tænder et lys, kommer der en lille **flamme**.
sentence.en: When you light a candle, a small flame appears.

en flaske.explanation: "En flaske" means "a bottle". Danish has no word for "of" here: en flaske vand is a bottle of water, and "et glas vand" is a glass of water.

sentence.da: Han hælder mælk fra en **flaske** i glasset.
sentence.en: He pours milk from a bottle into the glass.

en flaskeåbner.explanation: "En flaskeåbner" means "a bottle opener", a tool that pops the metal cap off a bottle. It is built from flaske (bottle) and åbner (opener).

sentence.da: Jeg kan ikke åbne flasken uden en **flaskeåbner**.
sentence.en: I cannot open the bottle without a bottle opener.

en fleksjob.explanation: "En fleksjob" means "a flex job", a job in Denmark for a person who can only work part of a normal week because of illness or injury. The municipality helps pay the wage.

sentence.da: Hun har en **fleksjob**, fordi hun ikke kan arbejde fuld tid.
sentence.en: She has a flex job because she cannot work full time.

en fletning.explanation: "En fletning" means "a braid", hair or other strands woven over and under each other, usually in three parts. The matching verb is at flette (to braid).

sentence.da: Hun satte sit lange hår i en **fletning**.
sentence.en: She put her long hair in a braid.

en flirt.explanation: "En flirt" means "a flirt", a playful moment of romantic interest between two people. The action of flirting is at flirte (to flirt).

sentence.da: Det var bare en **flirt**, ikke et rigtigt forhold.
sentence.en: It was just a flirt, not a real relationship.

en flise.explanation: "En flise" means "a tile", a hard, flat square used for floors and walls, most often in kitchens and bathrooms.

sentence.da: Jeg lægger en ny **flise** på badeværelsets gulv.
sentence.en: I am laying a new tile on the bathroom floor.

en flod.explanation: "En flod" means "a river", bigger than en å (a stream).

sentence.da: Der ligger en gammel by ved en bred **flod**.
sentence.en: An old town lies by a wide river.

en flok.explanation: "En flok" means "a flock" or "a crowd", for animals and for people: en flok får (a flock of sheep), en flok børn (a crowd of children).

sentence.da: En **flok** fugle sidder på taget.
sentence.en: A flock of birds is sitting on the roof.

en flok fugle.explanation: "En flok fugle" means "a flock of birds", a group of birds that fly or sit together. Flok works for other groups too: en flok børn (a group of children), en flok får (a flock of sheep).

forms.en: a flock of birds in the field

sentence.da: På marken sidder en **flok fugle** og spiser korn.
sentence.en: On the field sits a flock of birds eating grain.

en flue.explanation: "En flue" means "a fly", the small buzzing animal that lands on food. A bigger one that bites is en bremse (a horsefly).

sentence.da: Der er en **flue** i min suppe.
sentence.en: There is a fly in my soup.

en flybillet.explanation: "En flybillet" means "a plane ticket". It is built from fly (plane) and billet (ticket). Billet works for any ticket, like en koncertbillet (a concert ticket).

sentence.da: Uden en **flybillet** kan du ikke flyve.
sentence.en: Without a plane ticket you cannot fly.

en flygtning.explanation: "En flygtning" means "a refugee", a person who has left their country to be safe. The word comes from at flygte (to flee).

sentence.da: Hun kom til Danmark som **flygtning** i 2015.
sentence.en: She came to Denmark as a refugee in 2015.

en flygtningestrøm.explanation: "En flygtningestrøm" means "a flow of refugees", many people fleeing their homes at about the same time, usually because of war. It is built from en flygtning (a refugee) and en strøm (a stream), the same word that is used for electric current.

sentence.da: Krigen førte til en **flygtningestrøm** mod nabolandene.
sentence.en: The war led to a flow of refugees toward the neighboring countries.

en flyrejse.explanation: "En flyrejse" means "a flight" as a whole journey by plane. For the plane itself, use et fly: Flyet er forsinket (The plane is delayed).

sentence.da: En **flyrejse** til Spanien tager tre timer.
sentence.en: A flight to Spain takes three hours.

en flytning.explanation: "En flytning" means "a move" from one home to another, not a trip. It comes from at flytte (to move).

sentence.da: Ved en **flytning** pakker man alle sine ting i kasser.
sentence.en: In a move you pack all your things in boxes.

en flyttekasse.explanation: "En flyttekasse" means "a moving box", a sturdy cardboard box for carrying your things. It is built from at flytte (to move) and en kasse (a box). Kasse also means the checkout in a shop: Betal ved kassen (Pay at the checkout).

sentence.da: Jeg pakker alle bøgerne i en **flyttekasse**.
sentence.en: I pack all the books in a moving box.

en flyverdragt.explanation: "En flyverdragt" means "a snowsuit", a warm, padded one-piece suit that small children wear in cold weather. The word is flyver (a pilot) plus dragt (a suit), and it is also the name of the suit a pilot wears.

sentence.da: Når det er koldt, får barnet en varm **flyverdragt** på.
sentence.en: When it is cold, the child puts on a warm snowsuit.

en flyvetid.explanation: "En flyvetid" means "a flight time", how long a flight takes in the air. It is built from at flyve (to fly) and en tid (a time). En tid also means "an appointment", as in en tid hos lægen (an appointment with the doctor).

sentence.da: Til London er der kun to timers **flyvetid**.
sentence.en: To London there are only two hours of flight time.

en flåde.explanation: "En flåde" means "a fleet" or "a navy", a group of ships that belong together. It can also be a company's vehicles: en flåde af lastbiler (a fleet of trucks).

sentence.da: Landets **flåde** består af krigsskibe og ubåde.
sentence.en: The country's navy consists of warships and submarines.

en flåt.explanation: "En flåt" means "a tick", a tiny animal that bites into the skin and sucks blood. In Denmark it can spread an illness called borreliose (Lyme disease), so check your skin after a walk in the woods.

sentence.da: Efter skovturen fandt jeg en **flåt** på min mave.
sentence.en: After the forest trip, I found a tick on my stomach.

en flødebolle.explanation: "En flødebolle" means "a chocolate-covered marshmallow treat", a classic Danish sweet, often with a thin wafer base. The name is fløde (cream) plus bolle (a bun).

sentence.da: En **flødebolle** har et blødt fyld og et lag chokolade udenpå.
sentence.en: A flødebolle has a soft filling and a layer of chocolate on the outside.

en fløjte.explanation: "En fløjte" means both "a flute" and "a whistle": Hun spiller på fløjte (She plays the flute). Dommeren blæser i fløjten (The referee blows the whistle).

sentence.da: Hun spiller **fløjte** i skolens orkester.
sentence.en: She plays the flute in the school orchestra.

en fod.explanation: "En fod" means "a foot". Til fods means on foot (walking). Danish often says the feet where English says my feet: Jeg har ondt i fødderne means my feet hurt (literally I have a pain in the feet).

sentence.da: Skoen er for lille til min **fod**.
sentence.en: The shoe is too small for my foot.

en fodboldkamp.explanation: "En fodboldkamp" means "a soccer match". It is built from fodbold (soccer) and kamp (match). Fodbold is not American football.

sentence.da: Vi ser en **fodboldkamp** på tv i aften.
sentence.en: We are watching a soccer match on TV tonight.

en fodboldspiller.explanation: "En fodboldspiller" means "a soccer player". It is built from fodbold (soccer) and spiller (player). Fodbold is soccer, not American football.

sentence.da: En **fodboldspiller** løber efter bolden og skyder mål.
sentence.en: A soccer player runs after the ball and scores goals.

en fodgænger.explanation: "En fodgænger" means "a pedestrian", literally a foot-goer, from fod (foot).

sentence.da: En **fodgænger** skal vente, når lyset er rødt.
sentence.en: A pedestrian has to wait when the light is red.

en fodgængerzone.explanation: "En fodgængerzone" means "a pedestrian zone", a street area where cars are not allowed.

sentence.da: Der må ikke køre biler i en **fodgængerzone**.
sentence.en: Cars may not drive in a pedestrian zone.

en fodnote.explanation: "En fodnote" means "a footnote", a short note printed under the main text that explains something or says where it comes from. The name fits: fod (a foot) plus note (a note).

sentence.da: Forklaringen står i en **fodnote** nederst på siden.
sentence.en: The explanation is in a footnote at the bottom of the page.

en fodring.explanation: "En fodring" means "a feeding", the time when animals get their food. It comes from at fodre (to give an animal its food).

sentence.da: Dyrene får mad ved hver **fodring**.
sentence.en: The animals get food at each feeding.

en fold.explanation: "En fold" means "a fold", the line where cloth or paper is bent over. The matching verb is at folde (to fold).

sentence.da: Der er en **fold** i papiret, fordi jeg har lagt det sammen.
sentence.en: There is a fold in the paper because I have folded it.

en folkeafstemning.explanation: "En folkeafstemning" means "a referendum", a public question that all citizens answer themselves, such as whether to change a law. It is different from et valg (an election), where you choose people.

sentence.da: Ved en **folkeafstemning** kan alle stemme ja eller nej til et forslag.
sentence.en: In a referendum, everyone can vote yes or no on a proposal.

en folkepension.explanation: "En folkepension" means "a state pension", money paid by the state every month once you reach retirement age. The amount depends on how many years you have lived in Denmark.

sentence.da: Man kan få **folkepension**, når man bliver gammel nok.
sentence.en: You can get a state pension when you get old enough.

en folkeskole.explanation: "En folkeskole" means "a primary school", but it covers all of public school, from about age 6 to 16.

sentence.da: Min søn går i **folkeskole** og har mange venner.
sentence.en: My son goes to primary school and has many friends.

en forandring.explanation: "En forandring" means "a change", often a big one in someone's life, like a new job or a new home. The action is at forandre (to make different).

sentence.da: Efter ti år på kontoret vil jeg have en **forandring**.
sentence.en: After ten years at the office I want a change.

en forbandelse.explanation: "En forbandelse" means "a curse", words or a spell meant to bring bad luck to someone, as in old stories. It can also be a swear word: Forbandelse! (Damn!)

sentence.da: Ifølge sagnet hviler der en **forbandelse** over slottet.
sentence.en: According to the legend, a curse rests on the castle.

en forbedring.explanation: "En forbedring" means "an improvement", a change that makes something better. The opposite is en forværring (a worsening).

sentence.da: Det nye skema er en stor **forbedring**, fordi det er nemmere at læse.
sentence.en: The new schedule is a big improvement because it is easier to read.

en forbindelse.explanation: "En forbindelse" means "a connection", for internet or phone. It also means a tie between two things: Der er en forbindelse mellem søvn og humør (There is a connection between sleep and mood).

sentence.da: Jeg har ingen **forbindelse** til internettet lige nu.
sentence.en: I have no connection to the internet right now.

en forbinding.explanation: "En forbinding" means "a dressing", the soft cloth you wrap around a wound. A small sticky one is et plaster (a Band-Aid).

sentence.da: Han fik en **forbinding** på armen.
sentence.en: He got a dressing on his arm.

en forbruger.explanation: "En forbruger" means "a consumer", a person who buys and uses things in daily life, as opposed to the company that makes or sells them.

sentence.da: Som **forbruger** kan du klage, hvis varen er gået i stykker.
sentence.en: As a consumer, you can complain if the product has broken.

en forbrydelse.explanation: "En forbrydelse" means "a crime", an act that breaks the law and can end up in court, from small to very serious.

sentence.da: Det er en **forbrydelse** at stjæle fra andre.
sentence.en: It is a crime to steal from others.

en forbryder.explanation: "En forbryder" means "a criminal", a person who breaks the law. It comes from forbrydelse (a crime).

sentence.da: Politiet har fanget en farlig **forbryder**.
sentence.en: The police have caught a dangerous criminal.

en fordel.explanation: "En fordel" means "an advantage" or "a benefit". The opposite is en ulempe (a disadvantage).

sentence.da: Det er en **fordel** at bo tæt på arbejde.
sentence.en: It is an advantage to live close to work.

en fordeling.explanation: "En fordeling" means "a distribution", the way something is split up between people, groups or places. It often says whether the split is fair, and it comes from at fordele (to distribute).

sentence.da: Der er en skæv **fordeling** af arbejdet i gruppen.
sentence.en: There is an uneven distribution of the work in the group.

en fordom.explanation: "En fordom" means "a prejudice", an opinion about a person or a group that you formed before you really know them, and it is usually unfair. It is built from for (before) and dom (judgment).

sentence.da: Han har en **fordom** om folk, han aldrig har mødt.
sentence.en: He has a prejudice about people he has never met.

en forelæsning.explanation: "En forelæsning" means "a lecture", a teaching session where one teacher speaks to a large group, mostly at a university. You say at gå til forelæsning (to go to a lecture).

sentence.da: Studerende lytter og tager noter ved en **forelæsning**.
sentence.en: Students listen and take notes at a lecture.

en forening.explanation: "En forening" means "an association" or "a club", a group of people who meet regularly for a shared purpose.

sentence.da: I en **forening** mødes folk med samme interesse.
sentence.en: In an association, people with the same interest meet.

en forespørgsel.explanation: "En forespørgsel" means "an inquiry", a written message to a company that asks about something, such as whether it is available. In computing, a search in a database is also en forespørgsel (a query).

sentence.da: Vi har sendt en **forespørgsel** til hotellet om priser.
sentence.en: We sent an inquiry to the hotel about prices.

en forestilling.explanation: "En forestilling" means "a performance", a show for an audience. It can also mean "an idea": Jeg har ingen forestilling om det (I have no idea).

sentence.da: Børnene så en sjov **forestilling** i går.
sentence.en: The children saw a funny show yesterday.

en forfader.explanation: "En forfader" means "an ancestor", a family member who lived long ago. It is built from for (before) and fader (father). Do not mix it up with forældre (parents).

sentence.da: Min **forfader** boede her for længe siden.
sentence.en: My ancestor lived here long ago.

en forfatter.explanation: "En forfatter" means "an author", someone who writes books. The same word is used for men and women.

sentence.da: Hun er **forfatter** og har skrevet tre bøger.
sentence.en: She is an author and has written three books.

en forfremmelse.explanation: "En forfremmelse" means "a promotion", a move to a higher, better job at the same workplace, usually with more pay or more responsibility.

sentence.da: Efter ti år fik hun en **forfremmelse** til afdelingsleder.
sentence.en: After ten years she got a promotion to department head.

en forgænger.explanation: "En forgænger" means "a predecessor", the person who held a job or role before you, or an earlier version of a thing.

sentence.da: Den nye direktør er mere åben end sin **forgænger**.
sentence.en: The new director is more open than her predecessor.

en forhandler.explanation: "En forhandler" means "a dealer / retailer", a business that sells products from a maker to customers: en bilforhandler (a car dealer). Do not mix it up with en forhandling (a negotiation), which comes from the same verb.

sentence.da: En **forhandler** sælger varer fra flere fabrikker til kunderne.
sentence.en: A dealer sells goods from several factories to the customers.

en forhandling.explanation: "En forhandling" means "a negotiation", a discussion where two sides talk to settle something, such as a price, a salary or a contract.

sentence.da: Efter en lang **forhandling** blev parterne enige om en pris.
sentence.en: After a long negotiation, the parties agreed on a price.

en forhindring.explanation: "En forhindring" means "an obstacle", a thing that stands in your way and makes it harder to reach a goal, in sport or in life.

sentence.da: Den største **forhindring** er, at vi mangler tid.
sentence.en: The biggest obstacle is that we are short of time.

en forhøjelse.explanation: "En forhøjelse" means "an increase" that someone decides on, for example of a price or a rent: en skatteforhøjelse (a tax increase). It is made on purpose, unlike something that just grows by itself.

sentence.da: Efter en **forhøjelse** af huslejen kunne vi ikke blive boende.
sentence.en: After an increase in the rent, we could not stay.

en forklaring.explanation: "En forklaring" means "an explanation", what someone says to make a thing clear or to say why something happened. The action is at forklare (to explain).

sentence.da: Læreren gav en god **forklaring** på reglen.
sentence.en: The teacher gave a good explanation of the rule.

en forkortelse.explanation: "En forkortelse" means "an abbreviation", a shorter way to write a word or a name, such as osv. for og så videre (and so on) or FN for Forenede Nationer (the United Nations).

sentence.da: Kl. er en **forkortelse** for klokken.
sentence.en: Kl. is an abbreviation for klokken (the clock).

en forkærlighed.explanation: "En forkærlighed" means "a fondness", a special liking that makes you often choose one thing over others. It is followed by for: en forkærlighed for musik (a fondness for music).

sentence.da: Han har en **forkærlighed** for gamle biler.
sentence.en: He has a fondness for old cars.

en forkølelse.explanation: "En forkølelse" means "a cold", the illness with a runny nose and a sore throat. In everyday talk, Danes more often say Jeg er forkølet (I have a cold). Do not mix it up with kold (cold in temperature).

sentence.da: Jeg har en **forkølelse** og ondt i halsen.
sentence.en: I have a cold and a sore throat.

en forlovelse.explanation: "En forlovelse" means "an engagement", the promise to marry and the time that follows it. The person you are engaged to is din forlovede (your fiancé or fiancée), the same word for both.

sentence.da: De fejrede deres **forlovelse** med en middag for familien.
sentence.en: They celebrated their engagement with a dinner for the family.

en forlovelsesring.explanation: "En forlovelsesring" means "an engagement ring", the ring given when two people promise to marry.

sentence.da: Han gav hende en **forlovelsesring**, og hun sagde ja.
sentence.en: He gave her an engagement ring, and she said yes.

en forlover.explanation: "En forlover" means "a best man" or "a maid of honor", a close friend or relative who stands beside the couple at a wedding. The same word is used for a man and a woman. Do not mix it up with en forlovelse (an engagement), which is the promise to marry.

forms.en: a best man / maid of honor
the best men / maids of honor

sentence.da: Min bror skal være **forlover** ved mit bryllup.
sentence.en: My brother will be best man at my wedding.

en forlygte.explanation: "En forlygte" means "a headlight", the light at the front of a car. It is built from for (front) and lygte (lamp), and for- also means front in et forsæde (a front seat).

sentence.da: Bilens **forlygte** lyser op på vejen.
sentence.en: The car's headlight lights up the road.

en forlystelsespark.explanation: "En forlystelsespark" means "an amusement park", a park with rides.

sentence.da: I en **forlystelsespark** kan man køre i rutsjebane.
sentence.en: In an amusement park you can ride a roller coaster.

en forlængelse.explanation: "En forlængelse" means "an extension", more time or length added to something that already exists, such as a deadline or a contract. For the electric cord, use en forlængerledning (an extension cord).

sentence.da: Jeg bad om en **forlængelse** af fristen, fordi jeg var syg.
sentence.en: I asked for an extension of the deadline because I was sick.

en forlængerledning.explanation: "En forlængerledning" means "an extension cord". It is built from forlænge (to extend) and ledning (cord). Forlænge also works for time: at forlænge en aftale (to extend an agreement).

sentence.da: Der er langt til stikkontakten, men jeg har en **forlængerledning**.
sentence.en: It is far to the outlet, but I have an extension cord.

en form.explanation: "En form" means "a shape" and also "a baking pan": Huset har en rund form (The house has a round shape). Kagen bages i en form (The cake is baked in a pan). In Han er i god form (He is in good shape), it means fitness. A paper form is en blanket.

sentence.da: Kagen har en sjov **form**.
sentence.en: The cake has a funny shape.

en formand.explanation: "En formand" means "a chairman", the person who leads a group, a club or a union and runs its meetings. Both men and women are called formand.

sentence.da: Hun blev valgt til **formand** for foreningen.
sentence.en: She was elected chair of the association.

en formel.explanation: "En formel" means "a formula", a fixed way of working out an answer, written in letters and numbers: længde gange bredde (length times width) gives the area of a rectangle.

sentence.da: I fysik bruger man en **formel** til at regne farten ud.
sentence.en: In physics you use a formula to calculate the speed.

en formidler.explanation: "En formidler" means "a communicator", someone whose work is to explain knowledge to others, like a teacher or a science writer. It can also mean "an intermediary", someone who passes things between two sides.

sentence.da: En god **formidler** kan forklare svære ting på en enkel måde.
sentence.en: A good communicator can explain difficult things in a simple way.

en formidling.explanation: "En formidling" means "a communication", the act of making knowledge or art clear to others, as in museums and schools. It can also mean "mediation", bringing two sides together: boligformidling (helping people find a home).

sentence.da: Museets **formidling** gør historie levende for børn.
sentence.en: The museum's communication makes history come alive for children.

en formue.explanation: "En formue" means "a fortune", a very large amount of money or property: Det koster en formue (It costs a fortune). It can also mean everything a person owns, counted in money.

sentence.da: Han tjente en **formue** på at sælge huse.
sentence.en: He earned a fortune by selling houses.

en formular.explanation: "En formular" means "a form", a paper or online page with empty fields where you write your information. Only this kind of form is formular; the shape of something is en form (a shape).

sentence.da: Du skal udfylde en **formular** med navn og adresse.
sentence.en: You must fill in a form with name and address.

en fornemmelse.explanation: "En fornemmelse" means "a feeling" or "a sense", more like a hunch than an emotion, because you cannot prove it. It can also be a bodily sensation: en fornemmelse af kulde (a sense of cold).

sentence.da: Jeg har en **fornemmelse** af, at han kommer i dag.
sentence.en: I have a feeling he is coming today.

en fornyelse.explanation: "En fornyelse" means "a renewal", making a passport, contract or membership valid again. It comes from at forny (to renew).

sentence.da: Jeg skal have en **fornyelse** af mit pas.
sentence.en: I need a renewal of my passport.

en fornærmelse.explanation: "En fornærmelse" means "an insult", a rude or hurtful remark meant to make someone feel small. A common phrase is at tage det som en fornærmelse (to take it as an insult).

sentence.da: Han kaldte mig dum, og det var en **fornærmelse**.
sentence.en: He called me stupid, and it was an insult.

en fornøjelse.explanation: "En fornøjelse" means "a pleasure", for something nice you did or someone nice you met. It is also a polite reply to thanks: Fornøjelsen er min means "The pleasure is mine".

sentence.da: Det var en **fornøjelse** at arbejde med dig.
sentence.en: It was a pleasure to work with you.

en forpligtelse.explanation: "En forpligtelse" means "an obligation", something you must do because you have agreed to it, or because the law requires it.

sentence.da: En lejer har en **forpligtelse** til at betale husleje hver måned.
sentence.en: A tenant has an obligation to pay rent every month.

en forret.explanation: "En forret" means "a starter", the small dish you eat before the main one. It comes first on a menu, and you order it with til forret (as a starter).

sentence.da: Jeg tager suppe til **forret**.
sentence.en: I will have soup as a starter.

en forretning.explanation: "En forretning" means "a business", and also "a shop". For a shop, en butik (a shop) is more common in everyday talk.

sentence.da: Min far har en lille **forretning** i byen.
sentence.en: My father has a small business in town.

en forretningsrejse.explanation: "En forretningsrejse" means "a business trip", a trip you take for work rather than for fun, for example to meet customers abroad.

sentence.da: På en **forretningsrejse** betaler firmaet ofte for hotellet.
sentence.en: On a business trip, the company often pays for the hotel.

en forrude.explanation: "En forrude" means "a windshield", the front window of a car. The back window is en bagrude (rear window).

sentence.da: Der er en lille revne i min **forrude**.
sentence.en: There is a small crack in my windshield.

en forræder.explanation: "En forræder" means "a traitor", a person who secretly turns against a country, a group or a friend who trusted them. It is a very strong word and always an accusation: Han kaldte hende en forræder (He called her a traitor).

sentence.da: Den, der sviger sit eget land, er en **forræder**.
sentence.en: Whoever betrays their own country is a traitor.

en forside.explanation: "En forside" means "a front page / front", the first, outer page of a newspaper, magazine or book, with the title and the main picture. It can also be the front side of a thing, the opposite of en bagside (the back side).

sentence.da: Der er et billede af et fyrtårn på bogens **forside**.
sentence.en: There is a picture of a lighthouse on the front of the book.

en forsikring.explanation: "En forsikring" means "insurance", an arrangement where you pay a company so it covers a loss.

sentence.da: Vi har en **forsikring** på vores hus.
sentence.en: We have insurance on our house.

en forsinkelse.explanation: "En forsinkelse" means "a delay", the time something is later than planned, often for trains, buses and flights. To say something is late, use forsinket: Bussen er forsinket (The bus is late).

sentence.da: Toget har en **forsinkelse** på en time.
sentence.en: The train has a delay of one hour.

en forskel.explanation: "En forskel" means "a difference". To say between two things, use på: Der er en stor forskel på kaffe og te (There is a big difference between coffee and tea). To ask about it, say Hvad er forskellen? (What is the difference?).

sentence.da: Jeg kan ikke se nogen **forskel** på dem.
sentence.en: I can't see any difference between them.

en forsker.explanation: "En forsker" means "a researcher", a person whose job is to find out new facts by studying and testing, often at a university.

sentence.da: En **forsker** undersøger, hvorfor bierne forsvinder.
sentence.en: A researcher investigates why the bees are disappearing.

en forskudsopgørelse.explanation: "En forskudsopgørelse" means "a preliminary income assessment". It is the form where you tell the Danish tax authority what you expect to earn this year, so the right amount is withheld from your pay each month. You can change it during the year if your pay changes.

sentence.da: I en **forskudsopgørelse** skriver man, hvor meget man tror, man tjener.
sentence.en: In a preliminary income assessment you write how much you think you will earn.

en forsoning.explanation: "En forsoning" means "a reconciliation", the moment when people or groups who have been fighting become friendly again. It is a big word for a bitter or long-lasting quarrel, not for a small disagreement: Efter mange års tavshed kom forsoningen mellem brødrene (After years of silence the brothers made up).

sentence.da: Efter krigen kom der en **forsoning** mellem de to lande.
sentence.en: After the war there was a reconciliation between the two countries.

en forstad.explanation: "En forstad" means "a suburb", an area of homes just outside a big city. It is built from for (in front of) and stad (town), so it lies in front of the town. Farther out than a forstad is landet (the countryside), as in at bo på landet (to live in the countryside).

sentence.da: Vi bor i en **forstad** uden for København.
sentence.en: We live in a suburb outside Copenhagen.

en forstand.explanation: "En forstand" means "a mind / sense", the ability to think clearly and judge well: Hun har en skarp forstand (She has a sharp mind). With på (on) it means knowing a subject well: Han har forstand på vin (He knows a lot about wine).

forms.en: in the true meaning of the word

sentence.da: Hun har **forstand** på biler og kan hurtigt finde fejlen.
sentence.en: She knows a lot about cars and can quickly find the fault.

en forstuvning.explanation: "En forstuvning" means "a sprain", from twisting a joint such as an ankle or wrist. The matching action is at forstuve (to sprain).

sentence.da: Hun fik en **forstuvning** og kan ikke gå.
sentence.en: She got a sprain and cannot walk.

en forståelse.explanation: "En forståelse" means "an understanding", either knowing how something works: Jeg har en god forståelse af reglerne (I have a good understanding of the rules), or showing sympathy for someone's situation, often when asking people to be patient.

sentence.da: Tak for din **forståelse**, mens vi løser problemet.
sentence.en: Thanks for your understanding while we solve the problem.

en forsvarsspiller.explanation: "En forsvarsspiller" means "a defender", a player in football or handball who plays near their own goal. The word is forsvar (defense) plus spiller (a player).

sentence.da: En **forsvarsspiller** skal passe på, at modstanderen ikke scorer.
sentence.en: A defender must make sure the opponent does not score.

en forsyning.explanation: "En forsyning" means "a supply", a steady delivery of something people need, such as water or heat. The plural forsyninger (supplies) also means stored goods, such as food and fuel kept ready for a trip or a crisis.

sentence.da: Byen får en stabil **forsyning** af rent vand fra værket.
sentence.en: The town gets a stable supply of clean water from the plant.

en fortaler.explanation: "En fortaler" means "an advocate", someone who publicly speaks up for an idea, a plan or a cause. You name the cause after the word for (for): en fortaler for gratis skolemad (an advocate for free school meals).

sentence.da: Hun er en stærk **fortaler** for flere cykelstier i byen.
sentence.en: She is a strong advocate for more bike lanes in the city.

en fortid.explanation: "En fortid" means "a past", the time that has already gone, in history or in your own life: Hun har en spændende fortid (She has an exciting past).

sentence.da: Han taler ikke om sin **fortid**.
sentence.en: He does not talk about his past.

en fortjeneste.explanation: "En fortjeneste" means "a profit / merit". It is the money a business has left after paying its costs. It is also the credit someone deserves for something good: Det er hendes fortjeneste, at vi vandt (It is thanks to her that we won).

sentence.da: Efter udgifterne er der en **fortjeneste** på tusind kroner.
sentence.en: After the costs there is a profit of a thousand kroner.

en fortolkning.explanation: "En fortolkning" means "an interpretation", a person's own way of understanding what a text, a law or a work of art means. Different people can give different fortolkninger of the same thing.

sentence.da: Hver elev har sin egen **fortolkning** af digtet.
sentence.en: Each student has their own interpretation of the poem.

en fortsættelse.explanation: "En fortsættelse" means "a continuation", the part that comes after and carries on from something earlier, such as a second film in a story. Fortsættelse følger (To be continued) is what you see at the end of a story told in parts.

sentence.da: Filmen er en **fortsættelse** af den, vi så sidste år.
sentence.en: The film is a continuation of the one we saw last year.

en fortælling.explanation: "En fortælling" means "a story / narrative", something told in words, such as a tale or a short account of events. Unlike en historie, which also means history, fortælling is only used for a story.

sentence.da: En **fortælling** kan være sand eller opfundet.
sentence.en: A story can be true or invented.

en forudsigelse.explanation: "En forudsigelse" means "a prediction", a statement about what will happen later, based on facts or a feeling for how things go.

sentence.da: Hans **forudsigelse** viste sig at være rigtig.
sentence.en: His prediction turned out to be right.

en forudsætning.explanation: "En forudsætning" means "a precondition", something that must be true or in place before something else can work. In the plural it can also mean what someone brings to a task: Hun har gode forudsætninger for at blive læge (She has what it takes to become a doctor).

sentence.da: Tillid er en **forudsætning** for et godt samarbejde.
sentence.en: Trust is a precondition for good cooperation.

en forvaltning.explanation: "En forvaltning" means "an administration", the offices of a city or state that handle cases for citizens and run the daily work. It also means looking after money or property for someone else: forvaltning af en arv (managing an inheritance).

sentence.da: Byens **forvaltning** styrer skoler, veje og biblioteker.
sentence.en: The city's administration runs schools, roads and libraries.

en forventning.explanation: "En forventning" means "an expectation", what you think will happen, or what others want from you. A common phrase is at leve op til forventningerne (to live up to expectations).

sentence.da: Min **forventning** er, at det bliver en god dag.
sentence.en: My expectation is that it will be a good day.

en forværring.explanation: "En forværring" means "a worsening", a change where something gets worse, such as a sick person's condition or the weather.

sentence.da: Lægen frygter en **forværring**, hvis patienten ikke tager medicinen.
sentence.en: The doctor fears a worsening if the patient does not take the medicine.

en forårsdag.explanation: "En forårsdag" means "a spring day". It is built from forår (spring) and dag (day). I foråret means "in the spring".

sentence.da: Det er en dejlig **forårsdag**, og solen skinner.
sentence.en: It is a lovely spring day, and the sun is shining.

en forælder.explanation: "En forælder" means "a parent", one mother or father. You will more often hear the plural: Mine forældre bor i Aarhus (My parents live in Aarhus).

sentence.da: Som **forælder** vil man det bedste for sit barn.
sentence.en: As a parent you want the best for your child.

en fotobog.explanation: "En fotobog" means "a photo book", a book you design yourself online from your own photos and have printed, often as a keepsake or a gift.

sentence.da: I en **fotobog** samler man sine egne billeder fra en rejse.
sentence.en: In a photo book you collect your own pictures from a trip.

en fotograf.explanation: "En fotograf" means "a photographer", someone who takes pictures for a living.

sentence.da: Vi har brug for en **fotograf** til brylluppet.
sentence.en: We need a photographer for the wedding.

en frakke.explanation: "En frakke" means "a coat". It is longer and warmer than en jakke (a jacket). At tage frakken på means "to put the coat on".

sentence.da: Jeg tager min **frakke** på i kulden.
sentence.en: I put my coat on in the cold.

en franskmand.explanation: "En franskmand" means "a Frenchman" or "a French person". The country is Frankrig (France), and the language is fransk (French).

sentence.da: Min nabo er **franskmand**, og han bager godt brød.
sentence.en: My neighbor is a Frenchman, and he bakes good bread.

en fredagsbar.explanation: "En fredagsbar" means "a Friday bar", a weekly get-together at a workplace or university on Friday afternoon, where people have a drink and talk after the week.

sentence.da: Hver fredag mødes kollegerne til **fredagsbar** på kontoret.
sentence.en: Every Friday the coworkers meet for Friday bar at the office.

en fredsaftale.explanation: "En fredsaftale" means "a peace agreement", a deal signed by both sides to end a conflict between countries or groups. It usually comes after long talks.

sentence.da: En **fredsaftale** afslutter en krig mellem to lande.
sentence.en: A peace agreement ends a war between two countries.

en fregne.explanation: "En fregne" means "a freckle", a small brown mark on the skin. It is mostly said in the plural: Hun har fregner i ansigtet (She has freckles on her face).

sentence.da: En **fregne** er en lille brun prik på huden.
sentence.en: A freckle is a small brown dot on the skin.

en frekvens.explanation: "En frekvens" means "a frequency", how often something happens, or how fast a sound or radio wave vibrates.

sentence.da: Radioen sender på en bestemt **frekvens**.
sentence.en: The radio broadcasts on a certain frequency.

en frelser.explanation: "En frelser" means "a savior", someone who brings others out of great danger or trouble. With a capital letter, Frelseren (the Savior) means Jesus in Christian texts.

sentence.da: Folket kaldte ham deres **frelser**, fordi han reddede byen.
sentence.en: The people called him their savior because he saved the town.

en fremgangsmåde.explanation: "En fremgangsmåde" means "a procedure", the way you go about doing something. It is the word to use when there is a proper or fixed way to do a task: Der er flere fremgangsmåder til at søge om støtte (There are several ways to apply for support).

sentence.da: Manualen forklarer trin for trin, hvad den rigtige **fremgangsmåde** er.
sentence.en: The manual explains step by step what the right procedure is.

en fremlæggelse.explanation: "En fremlæggelse" means "a presentation" where you show your results or your work to others, mostly in school or at university. It is built from at fremlægge (to put forward).

sentence.da: Efter gruppearbejdet har hver gruppe en kort **fremlæggelse** for klassen.
sentence.en: After the group work, each group gives a short presentation for the class.

en fremmed.explanation: "En fremmed" means "a stranger", a person you do not know: Tal ikke med fremmede (Do not talk to strangers). Before another word, fremmed means "foreign": et fremmed land (a foreign country).

sentence.da: En **fremmed** bankede på døren i aftes.
sentence.en: A stranger knocked on the door last night.

en fremstilling.explanation: "En fremstilling" means "a production / portrayal". It can be the making of goods: Fremstilling af ost tager tid (Making cheese takes time). It can also be how something is described or shown, for example in a film: Filmens fremstilling af perioden er meget nøgtern (The film's portrayal of the period is very sober).

sentence.da: Bogens **fremstilling** af krigen er meget levende og detaljeret.
sentence.en: The book's portrayal of the war is very vivid and detailed.

en fremtid.explanation: "En fremtid" means "a future", the time that is still to come, for the world or for your own life.

sentence.da: Børnene skal have en god **fremtid**.
sentence.en: The children should have a good future.

en fremvisning.explanation: "En fremvisning" means "a showing / display", a planned event where something is shown to an audience. For a home that is for sale, Danes usually say en visning (a viewing) instead, which is the everyday word.

sentence.da: Museet holder en **fremvisning** af de nye malerier i morgen.
sentence.en: The museum is holding a showing of the new paintings tomorrow.

en fridag.explanation: "En fridag" means "a day off", a day when you do not work or go to school. It is built from fri (free) and dag (day), and fri also works alone: Jeg har fri i dag (I am off today).

sentence.da: Min mand har **fridag** på onsdag.
sentence.en: My husband has a day off on Wednesday.

en frihed.explanation: "En frihed" means "a freedom", the right to decide for yourself: Ytringsfrihed er en vigtig frihed (Freedom of speech is an important freedom). The word fri (free) is in the same family.

sentence.da: Børn har brug for **frihed** til at lege.
sentence.en: Children need freedom to play.

en frikadelle.explanation: "En frikadelle" means "a meatball", a fried patty of minced meat. It is a classic Danish dish, eaten hot with potatoes or cold on rye bread.

sentence.da: Han steger en **frikadelle** af svinekød i panden.
sentence.en: He fries a pork meatball in the pan.

en frist.explanation: "En frist" means "a deadline", the last day or time to do or hand in something. Two common verbs go with it: at overholde en frist (to meet a deadline) and at forlænge en frist (to extend a deadline).

sentence.da: Sidste **frist** for at aflevere opgaven er fredag.
sentence.en: The final deadline for handing in the assignment is Friday.

en frisure.explanation: "En frisure" means "a hairstyle", the way your hair is cut and arranged. It covers both the cut and the styling, while en klipning (a haircut) is only the cutting.

sentence.da: En kort **frisure** er nemmere at passe end langt hår.
sentence.en: A short hairstyle is easier to take care of than long hair.

en frisør.explanation: "En frisør" means "a hairdresser", and it also means the place where you get a haircut: Jeg har tid hos frisøren means "I have an appointment at the hairdresser's". A barber, who cuts men's hair, is en barber.

sentence.da: Jeg skal til **frisør** i morgen.
sentence.en: I am going to the hairdresser tomorrow.

en frisørsalon.explanation: "En frisørsalon" means "a hair salon", the shop where you get your hair cut or colored.

sentence.da: Hun får klippet håret i en **frisørsalon**.
sentence.en: She gets her hair cut at a hair salon.

en fritidsaktivitet.explanation: "En fritidsaktivitet" means "a leisure activity", something you do for fun in your free time, such as sport, music or crafts. It is built from fritid (free time) and aktivitet (activity).

sentence.da: Fodbold er en populær **fritidsaktivitet** for børn efter skole.
sentence.en: Soccer is a popular leisure activity for children after school.

en fritidsordning.explanation: "En fritidsordning" means "an after-school program", where children are looked after and play when school is over and their parents are still at work. The best-known kind is SFO, for the youngest school children.

sentence.da: Efter skole går han i **fritidsordning**, til hans far har fri.
sentence.en: After school he goes to an after-school program until his father is off work.

en frivillig.explanation: "En frivillig" means "a volunteer", a person who helps out in a club, a charity or at an event. The same word is also used to describe things and means "voluntary": Det er frivilligt (It is voluntary).

sentence.da: En **frivillig** arbejder uden løn for en god sag.
sentence.en: A volunteer works without pay for a good cause.

en frokostpause.explanation: "En frokostpause" means "a lunch break". It is built from frokost (lunch) and pause (break). Pause also stands alone: Skal vi holde en pause? (Shall we take a break?)

sentence.da: Vi holder **frokostpause** klokken tolv.
sentence.en: We take our lunch break at twelve.

en front.explanation: "En front" means "a front", most often the line where two armies fight. It is also the line where warm and cold air meet, as in weather reports.

sentence.da: Når en kold **front** kommer, falder temperaturen hurtigt.
sentence.en: When a cold front arrives, the temperature drops quickly.

en frugt.explanation: "En frugt" means "a fruit". For fruit in general, Danes usually leave out en: Jeg spiser meget frugt (I eat a lot of fruit). One piece of fruit is et stykke frugt.

sentence.da: Æbler og bananer er **frugt**.
sentence.en: Apples and bananas are fruit.

en frugthave.explanation: "En frugthave" means "an orchard", a garden with fruit trees. It is built from frugt (fruit) and have (garden). Have also looks like at have (to have), but en have is a garden.

sentence.da: Der vokser mange æbler i vores **frugthave**.
sentence.en: Many apples grow in our orchard.

en frugtplantage.explanation: "En frugtplantage" means "an orchard", a large piece of land with rows of fruit trees, grown to sell the fruit. It is built from frugt (fruit) and plantage (a plantation).

sentence.da: I en **frugtplantage** dyrker man æbler og kirsebær til salg.
sentence.en: In an orchard you grow apples and cherries for sale.

en frugtsalat.explanation: "En frugtsalat" means "a fruit salad", cut fruit mixed together, often as a dessert.

sentence.da: Hun laver en **frugtsalat** med æbler og bananer.
sentence.en: She makes a fruit salad with apples and bananas.

en frugtskål.explanation: "En frugtskål" means "a fruit bowl", a bowl that holds fruit at home and often stands on the table. It is built from frugt (fruit) and skål (bowl). Skål is also what you say when you raise a glass: Skål! (Cheers!)

sentence.da: Der ligger tre æbler i en **frugtskål**.
sentence.en: There are three apples in a fruit bowl.

en frustration.explanation: "En frustration" means "a frustration", the feeling when things do not work out.

sentence.da: Det er en stor **frustration**, når bussen er forsinket.
sentence.en: It is a big frustration when the bus is late.

en frysepose.explanation: "En frysepose" means "a freezer bag", a strong bag for food that goes in the freezer.

sentence.da: Jeg lægger brødet i en **frysepose** og fryser det.
sentence.en: I put the bread in a freezer bag and freeze it.

en fryser.explanation: "En fryser" means "a freezer", the very cold part of a kitchen where food is stored frozen. The same spelling also appears in Jeg fryser (I am cold), which is about a person feeling cold.

sentence.da: Maden holder sig længe i en **fryser**.
sentence.en: Food keeps for a long time in a freezer.

en frø.explanation: "En frø" means "a frog". Et frø is a different word and means "a seed", so en or et changes the meaning.

sentence.da: En **frø** hopper rundt ved søen og kvækker.
sentence.en: A frog hops around by the lake and croaks.

en frøken.explanation: "En frøken" means "a miss / young lady", an old-fashioned title for a young or unmarried woman, used before the last name: frøken Hansen. Today most people just use a first name, so you mostly meet the word in older books and films.

sentence.da: Hun er ugift og hedder derfor **frøken** Larsen i den gamle bog.
sentence.en: She is unmarried and is therefore called Miss Larsen in the old book.

en frøpose.explanation: "En frøpose" means "a seed packet", the small paper bag of seeds you buy for the garden. It is built from frø (seed) and pose (bag). Watch the article: et frø is a seed, but en frø is a frog.

sentence.da: Jeg købte en **frøpose** med gulerødder i dag.
sentence.en: I bought a seed packet with carrots today.

en fugl.explanation: "En fugl" means "a bird", an animal with feathers and wings that usually can fly.

sentence.da: Der sidder en **fugl** i træet og synger.
sentence.en: A bird is sitting in the tree and singing.

en fuglekasse.explanation: "En fuglekasse" means "a birdhouse", a small box that people hang in a tree as a home for birds.

sentence.da: Vi hængte en **fuglekasse** op i havens træ.
sentence.en: We hung up a birdhouse in the garden's tree.

en fugletur.explanation: "En fugletur" means "a birdwatching trip", a walk to look at birds. It is built from fugl (bird) and tur (trip). Tur also covers a short walk: at gå en tur (to go for a walk).

sentence.da: Vi tog på **fugletur** med kikkert tidligt om morgenen.
sentence.en: We went on a birdwatching trip with binoculars early in the morning.

en fugleunge.explanation: "En fugleunge" means "a baby bird", a young bird that is not grown yet. The last part, unge (a young one), is the word for the young of an animal.

sentence.da: Den lille **fugleunge** sidder i reden og piber.
sentence.en: The little baby bird sits in the nest and chirps.

en fuldmåne.explanation: "En fuldmåne" means "a full moon", when the moon looks like a complete bright circle. Danes also say fuldmåne for the night itself, without en: I nat er det fuldmåne (Tonight there is a full moon).

sentence.da: Natten er lys, når der er **fuldmåne**.
sentence.en: The night is bright when there is a full moon.

en funktion.explanation: "En funktion" means "a function", what something does or is used for: Telefonen har mange funktioner (The phone has many functions). It can also mean a person's role: i funktion som leder (in the role of leader).

sentence.da: Knappen har en vigtig **funktion**.
sentence.en: The button has an important function.

en fusion.explanation: "En fusion" means "a merger", when two businesses join to become one new business. The same word is used in science: kernefusion (nuclear fusion).

sentence.da: Bankerne har fået ét navn efter en **fusion**.
sentence.en: The banks have one name after a merger.

en fyldning.explanation: "En fyldning" means "a filling", the material that closes a hole in a tooth. Cakes and chocolates have a fyldning too, the soft part inside.

sentence.da: Jeg har fået en **fyldning**, fordi tanden havde et hul.
sentence.en: I got a filling because the tooth had a hole.

en fynbo.explanation: "En fynbo" means "a person from Funen", someone from the island of Fyn in the middle of Denmark. It is built from Fyn and -bo (resident).

sentence.da: Hun er **fynbo** og bor i Odense.
sentence.en: She is from Funen and lives in Odense.

en fyr.explanation: "En fyr" means "a guy" or "a fellow", and sounds casual: Han er en rar fyr (He is a nice guy). In a more formal way, say en mand (a man).

sentence.da: Min bror er en rigtig sjov **fyr**.
sentence.en: My brother is a really funny guy.

en fyring.explanation: "En fyring" means "a dismissal", when an employer ends someone's job. It comes from at fyre (to fire someone), which also means "to heat" with a stove, so fyring can also mean heating.

sentence.da: Efter en **fyring** har man ikke længere et job.
sentence.en: After a dismissal you no longer have a job.

en fysiker.explanation: "En fysiker" means "a physicist", a scientist who studies how matter, energy and motion work. Their field is called fysik (physics).

sentence.da: En **fysiker** undersøger, hvordan lys og lyd bevæger sig.
sentence.en: A physicist studies how light and sound move.

en fysioterapeut.explanation: "En fysioterapeut" means "a physiotherapist", someone who treats pain in muscles and joints with exercises and massage, for example after an injury.

sentence.da: En **fysioterapeut** viser dig øvelser, som gør din ryg stærkere.
sentence.en: A physiotherapist shows you exercises that make your back stronger.

en fåreflok.explanation: "En fåreflok" means "a flock of sheep", a group of sheep that graze and move together. It is built from får (sheep) and flok (flock). Flok also works for people: en flok børn (a group of children).

sentence.da: Der går en stor **fåreflok** på marken.
sentence.en: A big flock of sheep is walking on the field.

en fælde.explanation: "En fælde" means "a trap", set for animals: en musefælde (a mousetrap). It can also be a trick set for a person: at gå i fælden means "to fall into the trap".

sentence.da: Han stillede en **fælde** op for musen.
sentence.en: He set up a trap for the mouse.

en fællesspisning.explanation: "En fællesspisning" means "a communal dinner", where many people from the same building, club or town eat together. Often everyone helps cook in turns and pays a small amount.

sentence.da: Hver torsdag laver vi mad sammen til en **fællesspisning**.
sentence.en: Every Thursday we cook together for a communal dinner.

en færd.explanation: "En færd" means "a journey / conduct", an old word for a trip, and also for the way someone acts. In daily speech you mostly meet it in the phrase at være i færd med (to be in the middle of doing): Jeg er i færd med at lave mad (I am in the middle of cooking).

sentence.da: Hun er i **færd** med at pakke, fordi toget kører om en time.
sentence.en: She is in the middle of packing because the train leaves in an hour.

en færdighed.explanation: "En færdighed" means "a skill", something you have practiced until you can do it well, such as typing or baking. It is built from færdig (finished, ready), as in a skill you have mastered.

sentence.da: Det er en vigtig **færdighed** at kunne svømme.
sentence.en: It is an important skill to be able to swim.

en færdselsregel.explanation: "En færdselsregel" means "a traffic rule", a rule for people on the road, whether they drive, bike or walk. You will more often hear the plural: færdselsregler (traffic rules).

sentence.da: At stoppe ved rødt lys er en **færdselsregel**.
sentence.en: Stopping at a red light is a traffic rule.

en færge.explanation: "En færge" means "a ferry", a boat that carries people and cars across the water.

sentence.da: Vi tager en **færge** over til øen.
sentence.en: We take a ferry over to the island.

en fætter.explanation: "En fætter" means "a male cousin", the son of your aunt or uncle. Danish has a separate word for a female cousin, en kusine, while English uses cousin for both.

sentence.da: Min **fætter** er søn af min mors bror.
sentence.en: My cousin is the son of my mother's brother.

en fødegang.explanation: "En fødegang" means "a maternity ward", the part of a hospital where women have their babies. Women usually go there when labor starts.

sentence.da: Barnet kommer til verden på sygehusets **fødegang**.
sentence.en: The child comes into the world in the hospital's maternity ward.

en fødevare.explanation: "En fødevare" means "a food item", for example bread, milk or cheese. It is mostly used in the plural, fødevarer (foods), in the news and in rules, like Fødevarestyrelsen (the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration).

sentence.da: En **fødevare** er noget, man kan spise eller drikke.
sentence.en: A food item is something you can eat or drink.

en fødsel.explanation: "En fødsel" means "a birth", both the moment a baby is born and the hours of work before it. It is the first part of fødselsdag (a birthday).

sentence.da: Ved en **fødsel** kommer et barn til verden.
sentence.en: At a birth, a child comes into the world.

en fødselsdag.explanation: "En fødselsdag" means "a birthday". The usual greeting is Tillykke med fødselsdagen! (Happy birthday!). Danes say Jeg har fødselsdag (literally I have birthday) where English says It is my birthday.

sentence.da: I dag har jeg **fødselsdag** og får kage.
sentence.en: Today is my birthday, and I get cake.

en fødselsdagsfest.explanation: "En fødselsdagsfest" means "a birthday party", a party to celebrate someone's birthday, often at home with family and friends. It is built from fødselsdag (birthday) and fest (party). At the party, you say Tillykke med fødselsdagen! (Happy birthday!)

sentence.da: Vi har **fødselsdagsfest** med kage og gaver.
sentence.en: We have a birthday party with cake and presents.

en fødselsdagsgave.explanation: "En fødselsdagsgave" means "a birthday present", a gift for someone on their birthday. It is built from fødselsdag (birthday) and gave (gift). Gave also works in other gift words, like en bryllupsgave (a wedding gift).

sentence.da: Jeg køber en **fødselsdagsgave** til min mor.
sentence.en: I am buying a birthday present for my mother.

en fødselsdagskage.explanation: "En fødselsdagskage" means "a birthday cake", the cake served to the guests at a birthday party. It is built from fødselsdag (birthday) and kage (cake). Kage also appears in en småkage (a cookie).

sentence.da: En **fødselsdagskage** har ofte lys på.
sentence.en: A birthday cake often has candles on it.

en fødselsdato.explanation: "En fødselsdato" means "a date of birth", the day, month and year you were born. It is not the same as en fødselsdag (a birthday), the day you celebrate each year.

sentence.da: Min **fødselsdato** er 12. marts 1990.
sentence.en: My date of birth is March 12, 1990.

en følelse.explanation: "En følelse" means "a feeling", such as joy or fear. It can also be a hunch: Jeg har en følelse af, at det går godt (I have a feeling that it will go well).

sentence.da: Kærlighed er en stærk **følelse**.
sentence.en: Love is a strong feeling.

en følelse af lettelse.explanation: "En følelse af lettelse" means "a sense of relief", the feeling when a worry is gone. The frame en følelse af ... (a feeling of ...) works with other feelings too: en følelse af sikkerhed (a feeling of safety).

sentence.da: Der kom en **følelse af lettelse**, da prøven var slut.
sentence.en: A sense of relief came when the test was over.

en følger.explanation: "En følger" means "a follower", someone who follows your account online. It comes from at følge (to follow).

sentence.da: En **følger** kan se alle dine opslag.
sentence.en: A follower can see all your posts.

en føljeton.explanation: "En føljeton" means "a serial (story)", a story told in installments over time, on radio, on TV or in print. It is also used for any matter that keeps dragging on: Sagen er blevet en rigtig føljeton (The case has become a real saga).

sentence.da: En **føljeton** i avisen kommer i små dele, én hver dag.
sentence.en: A serial in the newspaper comes in small parts, one each day.

en føntørrer.explanation: "En føntørrer" means "a hairdryer". In everyday speech it is shortened to en føn, with the same meaning.

sentence.da: Mit hår er vådt, og jeg bruger en **føntørrer**.
sentence.en: My hair is wet, and I am using a hairdryer.

et fad.explanation: "Et fad" means "a dish", the large plate or bowl you serve food from. For your own food at the table, use en tallerken (a plate).

sentence.da: Hun lægger kødet på et **fad**.
sentence.en: She puts the meat on a dish.

et fadøl.explanation: "Et fadøl" means "a draft beer", beer poured from a tap instead of a bottle.

sentence.da: Vi tager hver et **fadøl** i baren.
sentence.en: We each have a draft beer at the bar.

et fag.explanation: "Et fag" means "a subject" at school. Put yndlings- (favorite) in front for your favorite: Mit yndlingsfag er historie (My favorite subject is history).

sentence.da: Matematik er et svært **fag**, men jeg kan lide det.
sentence.en: Math is a hard subject, but I like it.

et fagområde.explanation: "Et fagområde" means "a field of study", the area of knowledge a person studies or works in, such as law or biology.

sentence.da: Hun ved meget om sit **fagområde**, som er historie.
sentence.en: She knows a lot about her field, which is history.

et faktum.explanation: "Et faktum" means "a fact", something that is true and can be checked. Danes often open with Faktum er, at (The fact is that) to stress a point.

sentence.da: Det er et **faktum**, at vand koger ved hundrede grader.
sentence.en: It is a fact that water boils at a hundred degrees.

et fald.explanation: "Et fald" means "a fall" and "a drop": et fald fra stigen (a fall from the ladder), et fald i priserne (a drop in prices). The matching verb is at falde (to fall).

sentence.da: Der har været et stort **fald** i temperaturen.
sentence.en: There has been a big drop in temperature.

et familiebillede.explanation: "Et familiebillede" means "a family photo", built from familie (family) and billede (picture). Billede covers any picture, not just photos.

sentence.da: Der hænger et **familiebillede** over sofaen.
sentence.en: A family photo hangs over the sofa.

et familiemedlem.explanation: "Et familiemedlem" means "a family member". Medlem alone is used for a member of a club: et medlem af klubben (a member of the club).

sentence.da: Hvert **familiemedlem** fik en gave.
sentence.en: Every family member got a gift.

et fartkamera.explanation: "Et fartkamera" means "a speed camera", a camera that takes a photo of cars that go too fast.

sentence.da: Jeg bremser, fordi der er et **fartkamera** ved vejen.
sentence.en: I brake because there is a speed camera by the road.

et fartøj.explanation: "Et fartøj" means "a vessel" or "a craft", a broad word for anything that carries people or goods on water, in the air or in space. You see it in compounds such as luftfartøj (aircraft) and rumfartøj (spacecraft).

sentence.da: Et **fartøj** kan være et skib, et fly eller en rumraket.
sentence.en: A vessel can be a ship, a plane or a space rocket.

et felt.explanation: "Et felt" means "a field", but not a farm field. It is a box on a form: Skriv navnet i feltet (Write the name in the field). It can also be an area of work: Hun arbejder inden for dette felt (She works in this field).

sentence.da: Du skal udfylde hvert **felt** på siden.
sentence.en: You have to fill in every field on the page.

et feriested.explanation: "Et feriested" means "a vacation spot", a place people go to for a vacation.

sentence.da: Vi tager til et **feriested** ved havet i sommer.
sentence.en: We are going to a vacation spot by the sea this summer.

et fingeraftryk.explanation: "Et fingeraftryk" means "a fingerprint", the pattern of lines on the tip of a finger, which is different for every person. Police find them to show who touched something.

sentence.da: Politiet fandt et **fingeraftryk** på vinduet og kunne identificere tyven.
sentence.en: The police found a fingerprint on the window and could identify the thief.

et firben.explanation: "Et firben" means "a lizard", a small animal with four legs and a long tail that is quick to run away.

sentence.da: Et **firben** ligger på den varme sten og soler sig.
sentence.en: A lizard lies on the warm rock and sunbathes.

et firma.explanation: "Et firma" means "a company", a business that sells things or services.

sentence.da: Han har sit eget **firma** i Aarhus.
sentence.en: He has his own company in Aarhus.

et fitnessabonnement.explanation: "Et fitnessabonnement" means "a gym membership", a plan where you pay every month to use a gym. Abonnement (subscription) is also used for newspapers, phones and streaming: et abonnement på en avis (a subscription to a newspaper).

sentence.da: Jeg betaler hver måned for mit **fitnessabonnement**, men jeg går sjældent.
sentence.en: I pay every month for my gym membership, but I rarely go.

et fitnesscenter.explanation: "Et fitnesscenter" means "a gym", a place with machines and weights.

sentence.da: Mange mennesker træner i et **fitnesscenter** efter arbejde.
sentence.en: Many people work out at a gym after work.

et fjernsyn.explanation: "Et fjernsyn" means "a television", the device. To talk about watching it, say Jeg ser fjernsyn (I watch TV), or just tv.

sentence.da: Vi ser film på vores store **fjernsyn**.
sentence.en: We watch movies on our big TV.

et fjols.explanation: "Et fjols" means "a fool", someone who has done something silly. It is a mild insult, often said half as a joke: Hold nu op, dit fjols! (Stop it, you fool!)

sentence.da: Jeg følte mig som et **fjols**, da jeg glemte hans navn.
sentence.en: I felt like a fool when I forgot his name.

et flag.explanation: "Et flag" means "a flag", a piece of cloth that stands for a country or a group. To raise it, use at hejse (to hoist): Vi hejser flaget (We raise the flag).

sentence.da: Det danske **flag** er rødt med et hvidt kors.
sentence.en: The Danish flag is red with a white cross.

et flertal.explanation: "Et flertal" means "a majority", more than half of a group, for example of the people deciding something. In language classes, flertal also means the plural form of a word, the opposite of ental (singular).

sentence.da: Et **flertal** i Folketinget stemte for den nye lov.
sentence.en: A majority in Parliament voted for the new law.

et fly.explanation: "Et fly" means "a plane". En flyvemaskine (an airplane) also exists, but it is longer, and et fly is the everyday word.

sentence.da: Vi sidder i et **fly** over skyerne.
sentence.en: We are sitting in a plane above the clouds.

et flyselskab.explanation: "Et flyselskab" means "an airline", a company that flies passengers. It is built from fly (plane) and selskab (company). Selskab also means a party: Der er selskab hos naboerne i aften (There is a party at the neighbors' tonight).

sentence.da: Hvilket **flyselskab** flyver du med?
sentence.en: Which airline are you flying with?

et foder.explanation: "Et foder" means "feed", something for animals to eat, such as horses and pets. It also means the lining inside a coat or jacket, a different thing with the same word.

sentence.da: Køerne får **foder** i stalden om vinteren.
sentence.en: The cows get feed in the barn in winter.

et foderbræt.explanation: "Et foderbræt" means "a bird feeder", usually a flat board set up outside with food for wild birds, mostly in winter.

sentence.da: Mejserne spiser solsikkekerner fra et **foderbræt** i haven.
sentence.en: The tits eat sunflower seeds from a bird feeder in the garden.

et fodgængerfelt.explanation: "Et fodgængerfelt" means "a crosswalk", the marked stripes where people cross the road. Danes also say fodgængerovergang (pedestrian crossing).

sentence.da: Børnene går over vejen ved et **fodgængerfelt**.
sentence.en: The children cross the road at a crosswalk.

et fodspor.explanation: "Et fodspor" means "a footprint", the mark a foot leaves. It is built from en fod (a foot) and et spor (a track). Spor also means a clue: Politiet leder efter spor (The police look for clues).

sentence.da: Der er et **fodspor** i sneen foran døren.
sentence.en: There is a footprint in the snow in front of the door.

et fokus.explanation: "Et fokus" means "a focus", what you pay the most attention to. You say fokus på (focus on) something: Vi har fokus på sundhed (We focus on health). To draw attention to something, say at sætte fokus på noget (to put focus on something).

forms.en: The focus is on the children.

sentence.da: Vi har **fokus** på vores kunder.
sentence.en: We focus on our customers.

et folk.explanation: "Et folk" means "a people", a whole nation: Det danske folk (The Danish people). Folk is also everyday talk for people in general: Der er mange folk her (There are lots of people here).

sentence.da: Det danske **folk** elsker at cykle.
sentence.en: The Danish people love to cycle.

et folketingsvalg.explanation: "Et folketingsvalg" means "a general election", the election of the members of the Folketing, the Danish parliament. It is held at least every four years, and the result decides which parties lead the country.

sentence.da: Efter et **folketingsvalg** danner partierne en ny regering.
sentence.en: After a general election, the parties form a new government.

et forbud.explanation: "Et forbud" means "a ban", an official order that something is not allowed. Use mod (against) after it: et forbud mod mobiltelefoner (a ban on cell phones).

sentence.da: Der er et **forbud** mod at ryge på stationen.
sentence.en: There is a ban on smoking at the station.

et foredrag.explanation: "Et foredrag" means "a talk" or "a lecture", a spoken talk by one person to a group. Danes say at holde et foredrag (literally to hold a talk), not to give one.

sentence.da: Forfatteren holder et **foredrag** om sin nye bog på biblioteket.
sentence.en: The author gives a talk about his new book at the library.

et forhold.explanation: "Et forhold" means "a relationship", for example between two people: Jeg har et godt forhold til min søster (I have a good relationship with my sister). It also means how two things relate: Forholdet mellem pris og kvalitet er godt (The relation between price and quality is good).

sentence.da: Jeg har et godt **forhold** til min chef.
sentence.en: I have a good relationship with my boss.

et forholdsord.explanation: "Et forholdsord" means "a preposition", a small word such as på (on), i (in) or til (to) that shows how things relate to each other. På often matches English for: at vente på (to wait for).

sentence.da: På er et **forholdsord**, som viser, hvor noget er.
sentence.en: På is a preposition that shows where something is.

et forhør.explanation: "Et forhør" means "an interrogation", when the police question someone about a crime, sometimes for many hours. It is built from the verb at forhøre (to interrogate).

sentence.da: Politiet holdt et **forhør** med manden i flere timer.
sentence.en: The police held an interrogation with the man for several hours.

et forlag.explanation: "Et forlag" means "a publisher", a company that chooses, prepares and sells books, magazines or music for the people who made them.

sentence.da: Hun sender sit manuskript til et **forlag**, fordi hun vil udgive bogen.
sentence.en: She sends her manuscript to a publisher because she wants to publish the book.

et forlig.explanation: "Et forlig" means "a settlement", a deal that ends a conflict where both sides give up something. In Denmark it is also used when parties in parliament make a deal: et politisk forlig (a political deal).

sentence.da: Fagforeningen og arbejdsgiverne nåede et **forlig** efter lange forhandlinger.
sentence.en: The union and the employers reached a settlement after long negotiations.

et formål.explanation: "Et formål" means "a purpose", the thing something is done for. The little word after it is med (with): formålet med mødet (the purpose of the meeting), where English says of.

sentence.da: Hvad er dit **formål** med at rejse til Danmark?
sentence.en: What is your purpose in traveling to Denmark?

et fornavn.explanation: "Et fornavn" means "a first name", the name you are given at birth, before the family name. It is made of for (before) and et navn (a name).

sentence.da: Mit **fornavn** er Anna.
sentence.en: My first name is Anna.

et forord.explanation: "Et forord" means "a preface", a short text at the start of a book that comes before the chapters. It is built from for (before) and ord (word), so its opposite is et efterord (an afterword).

sentence.da: I et **forord** forklarer forfatteren, hvorfor hun skrev bogen.
sentence.en: In a preface the author explains why she wrote the book.

et forræderi.explanation: "Et forræderi" means "a betrayal", especially of someone who trusts you. As a crime against your country it is "treason", also called landsforræderi.

sentence.da: At sælge hemmeligheder til fjenden er et **forræderi** mod landet.
sentence.en: Selling secrets to the enemy is a betrayal of the country.

et forsikringsselskab.explanation: "Et forsikringsselskab" means "an insurance company", a company you pay every month so that it covers the costs if something goes wrong, such as a break-in or a car crash.

sentence.da: Mit **forsikringsselskab** betaler for skaden, hvis bilen bliver stjålet.
sentence.en: My insurance company pays for the damage if the car is stolen.

et forskud.explanation: "Et forskud" means "an advance", money paid before it is earned or due, such as part of your pay for work not yet done. På forskud means "in advance": betale på forskud (to pay in advance).

sentence.da: Jeg bad chefen om et **forskud** på min løn.
sentence.en: I asked the boss for an advance on my salary.

et forslag.explanation: "Et forslag" means "a suggestion" or "a proposal". You make one with at komme med et forslag (to come up with a suggestion): Har du et forslag? (Do you have a suggestion?).

sentence.da: Jeg har et godt **forslag** til middag.
sentence.en: I have a good suggestion for dinner.

et forspring.explanation: "Et forspring" means "a head start", the distance or time you are ahead of others at the start. It is also used for an edge in something else: et forspring i viden (a head start in knowledge).

sentence.da: Hun fik ti sekunders **forspring**, fordi hun var yngst.
sentence.en: She got a ten-second head start because she was the youngest.

et forsvar.explanation: "Et forsvar" means "a defense", protecting someone or something against harm. It is used for a country's military, for sport players who stop the other team from scoring, and in court. With a capital letter, Forsvaret is the name of the Danish armed forces.

sentence.da: Landets **forsvar** beskytter os mod angreb udefra.
sentence.en: The country's defense protects us against attacks from outside.

et forsøg.explanation: "Et forsøg" means "an experiment", and also "an attempt": Det var et godt forsøg (That was a good attempt). In a lab, it is a test of an idea.

sentence.da: Vi laver et **forsøg** med vand og salt.
sentence.en: We do an experiment with water and salt.

et fortov.explanation: "Et fortov" means "a sidewalk", the part of a street for people on foot. Bikes use en cykelsti (a bike path).

sentence.da: Jeg går på et smalt **fortov** langs vejen.
sentence.en: I walk on a narrow sidewalk along the road.

et forår.explanation: "Et forår" means "a spring", the season between winter and summer when the flowers come out.

sentence.da: Det er **forår** med mange blomster.
sentence.en: It is spring with many flowers.

et forældremøde.explanation: "Et forældremøde" means "a parent-teacher meeting", held at school for all the grown-ups of one class at once. A one-to-one talk about a single child is a skole-hjem-samtale (a school-home talk).

sentence.da: Til et **forældremøde** hører forældrene, hvad børnene laver i skolen.
sentence.en: At a parent-teacher meeting the parents hear what the children do at school.

et foto.explanation: "Et foto" means "a photo". It is short for et fotografi (a photograph).

sentence.da: Jeg sendte hende et **foto** af hunden.
sentence.en: I sent her a photo of the dog.

et fotografi.explanation: "Et fotografi" means "a photograph", the longer word. In daily talk people often say et foto (a photo).

sentence.da: Fotografen tager et **fotografi** med sit kamera.
sentence.en: The photographer takes a photograph with his camera.

et fradrag.explanation: "Et fradrag" means "a deduction", an amount you may subtract in your tax return, for example for long trips to work: et befordringsfradrag (a commuting deduction).

sentence.da: Et **fradrag** trækker man fra, før skatten beregnes.
sentence.en: You subtract a deduction before the tax is calculated.

et fredet område.explanation: "Et fredet område" means "a protected area", land or water that the law protects from building, hunting or damage. Fredet is also used for old buildings: en fredet bygning (a listed building), which cannot be torn down or changed freely.

sentence.da: I et **fredet område** må man ikke fælde træer eller samle blomster.
sentence.en: In a protected area you may not cut down trees or pick flowers.

et fremmedord.explanation: "Et fremmedord" means "a foreign word", a word that came from Latin, Greek, French or English and still feels foreign, such as fænomen (phenomenon) or demokrati (democracy).

sentence.da: Computer er et **fremmedord**, som vi bruger hver dag.
sentence.en: Computer is a foreign word that we use every day.

et fremskridt.explanation: "Et fremskridt" means "an advance", a move forward or a gain in skill. For progress in general, Danes say at gøre fremskridt (literally to do progress), not to make progress.

sentence.da: Jeg gør store **fremskridt** i dansk, fordi jeg øver hver dag.
sentence.en: I am making great progress in Danish because I practice every day.

et frikvarter.explanation: "Et frikvarter" means "a recess" or "a break" between lessons. It is built from fri (free) and kvarter (quarter hour). Fri also starts en fridag (a day off).

sentence.da: Efter to timer har vi et **frikvarter**, og så leger vi.
sentence.en: After two lessons we have a recess, and then we play.

et frimærke.explanation: "Et frimærke" means "a stamp" for a letter. A rubber stamp for ink is et stempel, so do not mix them up.

sentence.da: Du skal sætte et **frimærke** på brevet.
sentence.en: You have to put a stamp on the letter.

et frispark.explanation: "Et frispark" means "a free kick", a kick in soccer awarded after a foul. The other team has to stand back while it is taken.

sentence.da: Dommeren fløjter og giver os et **frispark** efter en hård tackling.
sentence.en: The referee blows the whistle and gives us a free kick after a hard tackle.

et frø.explanation: "Et frø" means "a seed". Do not mix it up with en frø (a frog), which has a different word before it: Frøen hopper (The frog jumps).

sentence.da: Fra et lille **frø** vokser et stort træ.
sentence.en: A big tree grows from a small seed.

et fuglekvidder.explanation: "Et fuglekvidder" means "birdsong", the twittering of many birds. It is built from fugle (birds') and kvidder (twittering).

sentence.da: Om foråret er haven fuld af **fuglekvidder**.
sentence.en: In the spring the garden is full of birdsong.

et fund.explanation: "Et fund" means "a find" or "a discovery", something that has been found, especially something old or important, such as objects dug up from the ground.

sentence.da: Arkæologerne gjorde et vigtigt **fund**: en gammel guldring i jorden.
sentence.en: The archaeologists made an important find: an old gold ring in the ground.
